new_reverse_comparison.status: New exact elementary implication derived here; not an original payment rule and not a proof of either open target.
new_reverse_comparison.statement: Universal eventual Pair Access monotonicity LT(Y)<=c LT(X)+h(T0) implies relaxed Coarse Double Q_B<=(3c/2)A on all reachable exactly paired-closed present-key sources. Thus the qualitative constant targets are comparable; they are different proof architectures rather than two independently easier conjectures.
proof: If A=0 then Q_B=0 by the banked zero-A cycle argument.

If A>0, cyclically cut W at an A-nontrivial access. Partition into blocks consisting of one A-nontrivial access to r followed by all consecutive A-noop accesses. Every such noop requests the same current A-root r.

In each block B changes at most once, at the first KEEP r. Replace the block by one access to r, KEEP iff the block contains a KEEP, otherwise DELETE. Its complete A/B state at both block boundaries is unchanged; the exact sums A and Q_B are unchanged. The compressed cycle remains exactly closed and reachable at its chosen seam.
The compressed cycle has one access per original A-nontrivial block. For each such d>=1, d+1<=3ceil(d/2), so LT_A(compressed)<=3A(W).

Append k repetitions of the compressed cycle to any fixed reaching prefix from (T0,T0). Apply eventual monotonicity to the whole request word and retained occurrence subsequence; divide by k and let k grow. Fixed reaching-prefix costs and h(T0) vanish, leaving LT_B(compressed)<=c LT_A(compressed).
new_reverse_comparison.limitations: This compares scalar assertions only. Moving a KEEP within its constant-root block creates no payment credit and is not licensed to modify any frozen literal original-ID charging interface. The original cycle costs are preserved exactly.
